harnessCorrections: The first standalone Settings invocation used an incomplete synthetic tenant without an allowed origin. The UI correctly refused its write with HTTP 400. The retry bootstrapped the workspace through the public identity route and left tracked code untouched.

Three shell wrappers lost their exit receipt when the shared temporary script was edited for the separate native Settings fixture retry. Their complete TAP streams recorded one passing test each. The receipt uses those streams.
The standalone screenshot harness used incorrect case for the Help center section heading on its first pass. The heading selector was corrected outside the checkout before proof was finished.
